entries.3339bb3d817918f8: This is the business of Shinkin Central Bank itself and is a reportable segment. As an individual financial institution, it conducts deposit, bond (financial debenture), lending, market operations, trading, settlement and trust businesses, among others, and as the central financial institution of Shinkin banks, it supplements the functions of various Shinkin bank operations, operates industry-specific safety net schemes such as the Shinkin management strengthening system, and works to maintain credit order in the Shinkin banking industry.
